title: Smart scan
description: Photograph an area, let AI assess the visible steps, then review them.

list.results: {count, plural, =0 {No scans} one {# scan} other {# scans}}
list.caption: Scans of your institution, newest first
list.photos: {count, plural, =0 {No photos} one {# photo} other {# photos}}

empty.title: No scans yet
empty.description: Start your first scan: photograph an area of your facility, AI assesses the steps the photos show, and you review and finalize the result.

noMatch.title: No scans match these filters
noMatch.description: Change or clear the filters to see every scan.

filters.label: Filter scans
filters.description: Narrow the list. Changes apply right away.

new.description: Choose the protocol, then photograph the area. AI assesses the steps the photos show; you review everything before finalizing.

details.title: What are you checking?
details.description: The protocol sets the checklist for this scan.

new.visualSummary: AI checks {visual, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} from the photos. You answer the other {manual, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}}.
new.visualAll: AI checks all {visual, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} from the photos. You review each verdict.
new.visualNone: No step of this protocol can be checked from a photo: you answer all {total, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} yourself.
new.areaHint: Name the exact place, so the report says where the scan was done.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: Add 1 to 4 clear photos of the same area.
photos.uploadHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Photos are resized and location data is removed before upload.
photos.tipLight: Good light, the whole area in frame, the camera held steady.
photos.tipClose: Add a close-up of labels, dates and fill lines.
photos.tipPrivacy: Do not photograph patients' faces or their information.
photos.full: This scan has the maximum of {max} photos.

camera.title: Take a photo
camera.description: Point the rear camera at the area and press the button.
camera.slowStart: Still waiting for the camera. If your browser asks, allow the camera, or upload a photo instead.
camera.denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow the camera for this site in your browser settings, or upload a photo instead.
camera.unavailable: No camera was found on this device. Upload a photo instead.
camera.unsupported: This browser cannot open the camera here. Upload a photo instead.
camera.busy: The camera is in use by another app. Close it and try again, or upload a photo.
camera.error: The camera could not start. Try again, or upload a photo.

ai.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {No AI analyses left today} one {# AI analysis left today} other {# AI analyses left today}}
ai.offNote: You can still save the scan and answer every step yourself.

new.submitHintPhotos: Add at least one photo to continue.
new.submitHintUploading: Wait for the photos to finish uploading.
new.submitHintFailed: Retry or remove the photos that failed.

noProtocols.title: No protocol to scan with yet
noProtocols.description: A scan follows a published protocol. Once a protocol is published, it appears here.

progress.title: Analyzing the photos
progress.analyzing: AI is checking the visible steps
progress.duration: This usually takes under a minute. You can leave this page: the result is saved with the scan.
progress.reconnecting: The connection dropped. Checking whether the analysis finished…
progress.slow: The analysis is taking longer than usual. It continues in the background; open the scan in a moment.

failed.title: The AI analysis did not finish
failed.description: The scan and its photos are saved. Try the analysis again, or continue and answer every step yourself.
failed.descriptionManual: The scan and its photos are saved. Continue and answer every step yourself.

photos.title: Photos
photos.count: {count, plural, =0 {No photos} one {# photo} other {# photos}}
photos.alt: Photo {number} of {total} of the scanned area: {area}
photos.zoomHint: Tap the photo to zoom in or out. When zoomed in, drag or scroll to move around.
photos.unavailable: This photo cannot be shown right now.

review.description: Check every step. AI verdicts count unless you change them; answer the steps the AI does not check, then finalize.
review.descriptionManual: Check every step and answer it from the photos and what you observed on site, then finalize.
review.aiCaution: AI can be wrong. Look at the photos and confirm or change each verdict.

step.lowConfidence: The AI is not sure. Look at the photos and decide yourself.
step.notVisible: The photos do not show this step. Decide it yourself, or leave it: it is then not counted, and the report lists it as not visible.
step.noAi: The AI has not assessed this step. Answer it yourself.
step.manualOnly: A photo cannot show this step. Answer it from what you observed or checked on site.

state.ai_accepted: The AI verdict counts when you finalize.
state.ai_flagged: Check this verdict: if you leave it, it counts as the AI gave it.
state.resolved: You decided a step the AI could not see.
state.unresolved: Not visible: not counted unless you decide.
state.unanswered: Required: answer this step before finalizing.
state.unansweredOptional: Optional: you may leave it unanswered.

step.notePlaceholder: What you saw, or why you changed the verdict
step.noteHint: Saved when you leave the box. Up to {max} characters.
step.changedHint: Add a short note on why you changed the AI verdict: it appears in the report.

summary.title: Result so far
summary.hint: Updates as you answer. Every answer is saved at once.
summary.unresolved: {count, plural, one {# step was not visible and is not counted.} other {# steps were not visible and are not counted.}}
summary.missing: {count, plural, one {Answer # required step to finalize:} other {Answer # required steps to finalize:}}
summary.unsure: {count, plural, one {Check # unsure AI verdict:} other {Check # unsure AI verdicts:}}
summary.ready: All required steps are answered. You can finalize.
summary.liveNotAssessable: No step can be counted yet.
summary.saveError: Some answers were not saved. Check the steps marked in red.

finalize.title: Finalize this scan?
finalize.description: The score and the risk level are saved, and the scan can no longer be changed.
finalize.unsure: {count, plural, one {# unsure AI verdict was not checked: it counts as the AI gave it.} other {# unsure AI verdicts were not checked: they count as the AI gave them.}}
finalize.unresolved: {count, plural, one {# not-visible step will not be counted.} other {# not-visible steps will not be counted.}}
finalize.done: Scan finalized. The report is ready.
finalize.waitSaving: Wait until your answers are saved.
finalize.notesFailed: Your notes could not be saved, so the scan was not finalized. Check the notes and try again.

analysis.title: AI analysis
analysis.notRun: The AI has not checked the photos of this scan yet. Run the analysis, or answer every step yourself.
analysis.failed: The last AI analysis did not finish. Try it again, or answer every step yourself.
analysis.running: The AI is checking the photos
analysis.runningHint: This usually takes under a minute. The page updates by itself when it is done.
analysis.slow: The analysis is taking longer than usual. It continues in the background; reload the page in a moment.
analysis.noVisual: No step of this protocol can be checked from photos: answer every step yourself.
analysis.done: The AI analysis is ready. Check each verdict.

notes.title: Examiner notes
notes.description: What the report should also say: context, actions taken, who was informed.
notes.label: Notes
notes.placeholder: e.g. Soap refilled during the visit; the ward manager was informed.

delete.title: Delete this scan?
delete.description: The scan, its answers and {count, plural, =0 {its notes} one {its photo} other {its # photos}} are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

errors.finalized: This scan is already finalized, so it can no longer be changed. Reload the page to see the report.
errors.incomplete: Some required steps are not answered yet.

report.finalizedOn: Finalized on {date}. The results can no longer be changed.

riskReason.critical: A critical step was violated, so the risk is high whatever the score.
riskReason.minorGaps: Every required step is compliant; only optional steps need attention.
riskReason.notAssessable: No step could be counted: every step was not applicable, not visible or left unanswered. So there is no score and no risk level.

steps.title: Steps
steps.caption: Every step of the protocol with the AI assessment, the final result and the examiner's note
steps.acceptedUnsure: AI verdict accepted without review, despite low confidence
steps.changedBy: Changed from the AI verdict by <person>{name}</person>

recommendations.title: What to improve
recommendations.description: The violated steps, most serious first, with a training scenario where one exists.
recommendations.none: No step was violated. Keep up the current practice.
recommendations.notAssessable: Nothing could be assessed, so there is nothing to recommend. Scan again with photos that show the steps, or answer them on site.
recommendations.noScenario: No training scenario for this protocol yet.

errors.network: No connection to the server. Check the internet connection and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.slowDown: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.refused: The AI declined to assess these photos.
errors.timeout: The AI took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.aiFailed: The AI answer could not be used. Try again.
errors.invalidPhoto: One of the photos could not be read. Remove it and add it again.
errors.photoTooLarge: This photo is too large. Use a photo under 8 MB.
errors.unsupportedImage: This photo format is not supported. Use a JPEG or PNG photo (on iPhone: Settings, Camera, Formats, Most Compatible).
errors.uploadFailed: The upload did not finish. Try again.
errors.photosUnavailable: Some photos are no longer available. Remove them and add them again.
errors.protocolNotFound: This protocol is no longer available. Choose another one.
errors.teamNotFound: This department no longer exists. Choose another one.
errors.analysisRunning: An analysis of this scan is already running.
errors.noVisualSteps: No step of this protocol can be checked from photos.
errors.storageFailed: The photos could not be read from storage. Try again.
